one_liner: Plain is a B2B customer support and ticketing platform.
self_serve_evidence: Developers can self-serve by creating a Machine User in their workspace settings to generate an API key.

one_liner: Help Scout is a customer support platform featuring shared mailboxes and live chat.
self_serve_evidence: Developers can generate OAuth 2.0 App ID and Secret directly from the My Apps section in their Profile settings.

one_liner: Gorgias is an ecommerce helpdesk and customer service platform built specifically for online stores.
self_serve_evidence: Users can generate a REST API key directly from the REST API section under their account settings.

one_liner: Slack is a cloud-based team communication and collaboration platform.
self_serve_evidence: Developers can create an app and generate tokens from the Slack API dashboard without admin approval for their own workspace.

one_liner: Discord is a voice, video and text chat app designed for communities and gamers.
self_serve_evidence: Developers can instantly create a new application and generate bot tokens via the Discord Developer Portal.

one_liner: Telegram is a globally accessible, encrypted, cloud-based centralized instant messaging service.
self_serve_evidence: Developers can create bots and get access tokens instantly by chatting with BotFather on Telegram.

one_liner: WhatsApp Business provides APIs for businesses to communicate with their customers at scale.
self_serve_evidence: Developers can use the Meta App Dashboard to add the WhatsApp product and generate temporary access tokens for testing.

one_liner: Google Ads API allows developers to programmatically manage and automate Google Ads accounts and campaigns.
self_serve_evidence: API access requires applying for a developer token which must be manually reviewed and approved by Google.
blocker: Requires manual review and approval of the developer token by Google.

one_liner: Meta Ads API enables developers to programmatically manage Facebook and Instagram advertising campaigns.
self_serve_evidence: Developers can generate System User Access Tokens from the Business Manager settings without requiring external review for owned assets.

one_liner: LinkedIn Marketing Developer Platform allows programmatic management of LinkedIn ad campaigns and reporting.
self_serve_evidence: API access requires submitting an application for the LinkedIn Marketing Developer Platform which must be approved by LinkedIn.
blocker: Requires approval for the LinkedIn Marketing Developer Program.
